# specs/sec-filing-ingestion-roadmap.md

> For agentic workers: REQUIRED SKILL: derive-roadmap — resume via its
> reconcile step; route each unticked stage per its ROUTING line; never plan
> this document wholesale.

## Outcomes

Source: your partner's words, 2026-11-06. Background: specs/sec-filing-index-ingestion-spec.md (covers O1 only; its §2.2 excludes O2–O3), specs/sec-filing-index-ingestion-adr.md (Proposed, not accepted).
Choices made: Python 3.14 in a uv workspace of four packages (repository scaffold).

| # | Outcome | Track | Rank | Cost (estimate; basis) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| O1 | The quarterly and daily index files, ingested into one filing-index table | A | 1 | Small: about 130 quarterly files since 1993 plus one daily file per business day, minutes of downloading at 3 requests/s; SEC full-index and daily-index directories |
| O2 | The individual submissions that the index rows name, downloaded | A | 2 | Large: millions of files, weeks for the full history at 3 requests/s; index row count × request rate, not yet measured |
| O3 | 10-K and 8-K filings handled: picked out of the submissions, with their main documents extracted | A | 3 | Unknown until submissions are on disk; measured by Stage 3 |

Tracks: A — SEC filing ingestion (known progression).

## Stages

- [ ] Stage 1: Filing-index table from real index files
      Objective: Build one filing-index table from the real quarterly and daily master index files.
      Outcomes: O1
      Consumes: nothing (package scaffolds only)
      Produces: a queryable filing-index table covering 1993 through the latest daily index; specs/sec-filing-ingestion-stage-1-findings.md
      Exit: O1 — the table holds rows from every quarterly master index since 1993 and every daily master index since the latest closed quarter, and it can be queried by CIK, form type and filing date; the findings file records files fetched, bytes, row counts, any files that failed to parse, elapsed time and the observed request rate of the real run.
      Leaves out: manifests and traceability → Stage 4; point-in-time awareness → Stage 5; full validation suite → Stage 6; scheduling and deployment → Stage 7
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 2: Submissions download
      Objective: Download the individual submissions that the index rows name.
      Outcomes: O2
      Consumes: Stage 1's filing-index table
      Produces: submissions on disk, each locatable from its index row; specs/sec-filing-ingestion-stage-2-findings.md
      Exit: O2 — every submission named by one real quarter's index rows is on disk or listed as failed; the findings file records files, bytes, failures, elapsed time and the extrapolated full-history duration.
      Leaves out: manifests and traceability → Stage 4; point-in-time awareness → Stage 5; full validation suite → Stage 6; scheduling and deployment → Stage 7
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 3: 10-K and 8-K handling
      Objective: Pick 10-K and 8-K filings out of the downloaded submissions and extract each one's main document.
      Outcomes: O3
      Consumes: Stage 2's submissions on disk
      Produces: 10-K and 8-K main documents extracted, linked to their index rows; specs/sec-filing-ingestion-stage-3-findings.md
      Exit: O3 — for the downloaded quarter, each 10-K and 8-K (amendments included) has its main document extracted or is listed with a reason; the findings file records counts, failures and elapsed time.
      Leaves out: manifests and traceability → Stage 4; point-in-time awareness → Stage 5; full validation suite → Stage 6; scheduling and deployment → Stage 7
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 4: Manifests and traceability
      Objective: Record each source file, its hash and its processing state, so every output traces to retained source bytes and reprocesses without a new download.
      Outcomes: O1, O2, O3 (hardened)
      Consumes: Stages 1–3 outputs
      Produces: manifests and traceability over index files, submissions and extracted documents
      Exit: O1–O3 — any index row, submission or extracted document traces to its source URL and hash; a parser change re-runs from retained bytes with no SEC request; an interrupted run resumes without redoing completed files.
      Leaves out: point-in-time awareness → Stage 5; full validation suite → Stage 6; scheduling and deployment → Stage 7
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 5: Point-in-time awareness
      Objective: Version the filing-index table so later quarterly corrections are reconciled without losing earlier states.
      Outcomes: O1 (hardened)
      Consumes: Stage 4's manifests and traceability
      Produces: versioned filing-index generations with recorded changes
      Exit: O1 — a re-read quarterly index that differs from the published one yields a new generation with its additions, updates and removals recorded, and the prior generation stays readable.
      Leaves out: full validation suite → Stage 6; scheduling and deployment → Stage 7
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 6: Full validation suite
      Objective: Cover the historical index and filing formats and the failure cases with committed fixtures.
      Outcomes: O1, O2, O3 (hardened)
      Consumes: Stages 1–5 outputs
      Produces: a fixture-based test suite that runs with no SEC access
      Exit: O1–O3 — CI passes on fixtures spanning the supported date range's index formats, malformed and HTML-error sources, and 10-K/8-K document variants, with no network access.
      Leaves out: scheduling and deployment → Stage 7
      ROUTING: brainstorming

- [ ] Stage 7: Scheduling and deployment
      Objective: Run daily ingestion and periodic reconciliation on a schedule in a deployed environment.
      Outcomes: O1, O2, O3 (hardened)
      Consumes: Stages 1–6 outputs
      Produces: a deployed, scheduled pipeline with run reports and alerts
      Exit: O1–O3 — scheduled daily runs ingest new index files and their submissions; observed scheduled executions, not a manual run, show it.
      Leaves out: nothing
      ROUTING: brainstorming

## Stage-spec stamp

Every stage spec's Rollout note carries this line, which writing-plans copies verbatim into the stage plan's header:

> Roadmap: specs/sec-filing-ingestion-roadmap.md, Stage N — on plan completion, tick the stage and re-validate later stages against what shipped.

## Completion

When every stage is ticked, run derive-roadmap §6 over the Outcomes list (O1–O3): one verdict per outcome with evidence (implementing stage and plan, Deviation notes, deferred_items entries). Each unmet outcome exits as a new stage or a conscious deferral with a written why.
